based_on: Staff recommend that City Council state its intention to designate the property at 66 Gerrard Street East under Part IV, Section 29 of the Ontario Heritage Act.
This property includes entrance addresses at 366, 368, and 370 Church Street and 64 Gerrard Street East.
The property is located at the northwest corner of Gerrard Street East and Church Street in the Downtown Yonge East neighbourhood.
If there are no objections to the designation, staff recommend that City Council let the City Solicitor introduce a bill to designate the property.
Designation lets City Council review proposed changes or demolitions and enforce heritage maintenance standards.
The property has historical value because of its direct links to a person and businesses significant to Toronto's LGBTQ+ community.
There are no financial impacts to the City from the recommendations in this report.
